supplement_reason: Frozen128ms44.588Hz guard excludes allA3/C4 because their fundamentals are only about41.76Hz apart. 160ms reduces the same guard to38.338Hz, with80ms half-window blur. No source/native fit or threshold relaxation.
prior128_no_eligible_error_note: Zero initialized worst error with zero eligible frames in prior128ms report is not validated zero error; treat as null.
method: Existing160ms Hann periodogram band power, frequency-adaptive H1 and harmonics; Hh/H1 from same frame. No source separation.
collision_rule: Minimum of per-frame and frozen-early-median other-ladder H1..H12 separations; no relaxation after another note disappears.
coverage_rule: At least95% of each160ms frame H1 analytic amplitude above own early-median minus40dB floor. This censors observable loss of support, not key-off times.
synthetic_acceptance: Per pair, maximum full-mixture minus exact fixed ratio error<=0.75dB across all synthetic frames passing observable masks and lying fully before known closure. Known-closure-straddling frames are reported separately, never used to identify source gates.
source_mask: Frozen observable masks AND synthetic per-pair acceptance. Independent of all native outputs.

synthetic.pitch: Interpolate prior source F0 only where prior H1 remains within30dB of its early level; hold nearest reliable endpoint. Same paths in known controls.
synthetic.purpose: Illustrative known truth, not source envelope or gate calibration. Isolated-note counterparts separate window error from cross-note leakage.

native_policy: All source-valid frames retained; raw ratio residual and separate30dB weak-native flag penalty/count, no composite score or native-dependent mask.
limits: Same reused development recording, no blind validation.
160ms windows temporally blur release and shared AM; no instantaneous spectral trajectory or gate claim.
Band ratios can reflect filter movement, phase cancellation, different voices or capture processing; VCF is not uniquely identified.
Known synthetic controls do not bound every possible source spectrum, phase or modulation history.
